clips.title: The story
paras: In the Valley of Trials, Gornek gives young Darkspear troll shamans a stone message. It sends promising mystics to Shikrik to begin formal communion with the elements.

Gornek gives the rune-carved stone to initiates who prove their mettle in the Valley of Trials. The troll shaman Ishi-yo sent it to direct them to Shikrik, the shaman trainer. For Darkspear trolls, the tablet begins a shared path with the orcs, joining their old spiritual traditions with the shamanic heritage Warchief Thrall has renewed.
